newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet postpones May 29 general meeting.
newsitem.headline: Eramet postpones May 29 general meeting.

text.p: French mining group Eramet said on Tuesday it had postponed an annual general meeting called for May 29 to give itself more time to consider a number of requests put forward by shareholders and staff.
A new date for the meeting will be set by the board which is due to meet "very soon", the company said in a statement.
Eramet said it had received a number of draft resolutions from state holding Erap as well as other shareholders, but did not disclose the subject of those proposals.
Erap, which has a seat on the Eramet board, has criticised the way the company has handled a recent dispute over the distribution of mining assets in New Caledonia.
Eramet said staff representatives wanted employees given the chance to select three directors under a 1983 public sector law.
"The board, which will meet very soon, will release its position on all these requests as well as the new date for the general meeting," the statement said.
